title: GetLinkedRef - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script Gets the reference linked to this one. If there is no linked reference, it returns None. Syntax: ObjectReference Function GetLinkedRef(Keyword apKeyword = None) native Parameters: - apKeyword: Keyword to specify which linked ref you want. Default: None Return Value: The ObjectReference linked to this one for the given Keyword, or None if there isn't any. Examples: ; Get the linked ref for the parent marker ObjectReference linkedRef = parentMarker.GetLinkedRef()
; Get the linked ref for the special keyword ObjectReference specialRef = parentMarker.GetLinkedRef(SpecialKeyword) See Also: - ObjectReference Script - GetNthLinkedRef - ObjectReference - SetLinkedRef - ObjectReference
